page.layout: Two columns of index entries under the running title INDEX. Left column first, then right column. Below the right column, at the foot, a signature mark "n 2" with the final line "170." of the right column beside it.

main_text.l: Antichrifti praecursor primitum in Ecclesia occupans 48
Antichriftum subinde de teriorum[?] in Christum & Ecclesiam moliturum 528
de Antichrifto nato Flu-entim[?] praefulis opinio 215
Antonius de Padua in-ter divos relatus 286

page.notes: The index is set in two columns, and the numerals of each column belong to that column. "Antichrifti laniones" is read as "latíones" (lationes) with a doubtful reading; "Flu-entim" is doubtful; "teriorum" is doubtful; "22[?]" in the locus line is hard to read. The first line of the right column reads "22" with the closing mark illegible. The line "n 2" is taken as the gathering signature. The lines of the Apocalypsis locus entry are separated where the printer broke them. Stains and show-through are omitted.
